headline: Medium prompt-injection and data-leakage risks arise from ChatGPT Desktop’s file/clipboard/screen surfaces interacting with nuwa-skill’s allowlisted egress.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can read files, clipboard, screenshots, and supported macOS app content by default, so attacker-controlled content can reach its instruction parser. nuwa-skill has allowlisted network egress, but its prompt-handling is undocumented here, so the pairwise bridge is inferred rather than proven. Uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop ingests untrusted file or clipboard content as instructions, injection is possible.
IF nuwa-skill forwards ChatGPT-produced text into a downstream prompt without sanitization, the attack can propagate.
mitigations: Disable clipboard and screen-capture workflows for untrusted content.
Use a strict prompt delimiter and instruction/content separation.
Require manual review before any copied text is reused.
Restrict nuwa-skill to a fixed template with no free-form instruction fields.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging for all imported content.

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code, while nuwa-skill has allowlisted egress. That creates a plausible path for sensitive material to leave the pair if nuwa-skill transmits ChatGPT-derived context. The exact destination is undocumented, so I do not escalate to high, but the shared data path exists.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop processes uploaded files or screenshots containing sensitive data, leakage risk exists.
IF nuwa-skill sends that derived context over its allowlisted network path, data can leave the local environment.
mitigations: Avoid placing secrets in files or screenshots used with ChatGPT Desktop.
Turn off or narrow nuwa-skill network access to only required endpoints.
Redact sensitive fields before copying outputs between agents.
Use separate workspaces for sensitive and non-sensitive tasks.
requires-engineering: enforce DLP checks on outbound prompts.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop has no filesystem write, no shell, and no git modification, so it cannot directly contend for mutable local resources with nuwa-skill based on the profiles shown. nuwa-skill only advertises allowlisted egress. With no overlapping write surface documented, conflict is limited.
conditions: IF nuwa-skill is extended with local write or git privileges, write conflicts could emerge.
IF an external orchestrator grants both agents the same mutable resource, contention becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only on shared local assets.
Do not grant shared git or filesystem write access.
Run them in separate sessions or containers.
Document any future mutable scopes before enabling them.
requires-engineering: add locking for shared resources.

D_cascading_error.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can produce code and file-derived outputs, and nuwa-skill may consume those outputs while having network egress. Because no verification or critique step is documented for the pair, B may treat A’s output as authoritative and act on it. The interaction is inferred, so medium is the cautious choice.
conditions: IF nuwa-skill uses ChatGPT Desktop output as an input prompt or decision source, cascading errors can propagate.
IF downstream actions are taken without independent verification, incorrect facts can be operationalized.
mitigations: Require a human check before acting on A’s outputs.
Add a verification step that cross-checks claims against sources.
Limit nuwa-skill to summarization, not execution.
Separate generation from action-taking workflows.
requires-engineering: implement citation and provenance validation.

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop explicitly touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code, but nuwa-skill’s residency, retention, and certification posture is not documented here. With only one side’s compliance surface visible, I can only identify a potential mismatch, not a confirmed breach. The uncertainty keeps this at low.
conditions: IF regulated data is placed into ChatGPT Desktop workflows, compliance review is required.
IF nuwa-skill stores or transmits the same regulated data under different retention or residency rules, a mismatch exists.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair until policies are confirmed.
Review retention and residency terms for both tools.
Use de-identified samples for testing.
Log which data classes each workflow touches.
requires-engineering: align policy enforcement across both systems.
